questions.text: Which of the following properties is true for a parallelogram?
options: Only one pair of opposite sides is parallel

questions.text: If one side of a parallelogram is 8cm and the adjacent side is 6cm, what is the perimeter?
questions.hint: Perimeter is the sum of all sides. Opposite sides are equal.
